## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, realistic-feeling hurricane season simulator in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Randomly select an Earth ocean basin; simulate storms and their impacts.
- Retire devastating storm names and replace them with a name beginning with the same letter.
- Continue the calendar into a new year after December 31.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a standalone responsive `index.html` with a custom canvas map and no game framework.
- Chose simplified basin-specific storm generation, storm tracking, evacuation decisions, damage, and public-trust mechanics.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a playable simulator UI with seven randomly selected basins, storm tracking, simulation controls, season stats, advisory log, and evacuation orders.
- Added year rollover and persistent retired-name replacements across new seasons.
- Confirmed JavaScript syntax with `new Function(...)`.
- Generated and read a browser screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/tempest.png`.

### Active
- Validate gameplay behavior and improve any issues found.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` could not run because its expected Chromium installation was missing.
- The requested JPEG screenshot was not produced; only the PNG was generated.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current `index.html` and validate the game in a browser, including storm formation, landfall, retirement/replacement, and year rollover.
2. If possible, produce and inspect the requested small JPEG screenshot.
3. Report assumptions and verification results; changes are currently uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/tempest.png`: Browser screenshot generated for visual checking.

## Important Context
- A Python server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The custom game logic and UI are all in `index.html`; no existing game files were present.
- Browser launch via `playwright-cli` failed with: `Browser "chromium" is not installed; expected executable at /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome.`
